## Wave 1 Summary

This wave discharges the single HELD Level-3 row of the EXISTING §VII.CB cross-pillar bridge (Pillar I↔VI↔IV: acoustic ↔ Hawking-transit ↔ a₂-emergent-metric). The §VII.CB theorem-STRUCTURE landed STAGE-3-PERMANENT at S106 (binding Element-4 `L⁻³` envelope `943b17ad…` + Level-1 cohomology-class identity `[T^{(IV)}]_{a₂,HKR} = [g_M]_{a₂,HKR}` + complete 5-anatomy), but the S106 W3 viicb workshop surgically demoted the Level-3 row to `NOT-SATISFIED-PENDING-MAGNITUDE-CONVERGENCE-ANCHOR`. The reason: the supplied S106 Level-3 anchor (`7.500e-09`) witnesses the SIGN channel `S(L) = (r_g, anec) → {1,1}` — which is analytically FLAT by the multiplicative-normalization cancellation fingerprint (`math-scripts.md §"Multiplicative-normalization cancellation invariants"`, K=3 MANDATORY: `c_BLV` cancels in the dimensionless ratios) — and is channel-ORTHOGONAL to the MAGNITUDE channel `M(L)` the Level-2 `L⁻³` envelope actually bounds.

This wave's single gate computes the MAGNITUDE channel directly: `M(L) = Tr_{M₂(ℂ)}(P_a₂ · T^{(IV)})|_L` (a finite-L spectral-triple M₂(ℂ) trace, NOT a continuum radial-profile compute — the S105 artifact evaluates `Γ_sub` on a radial grid `v(r)` and never represents it on the spectral triple), with residual `res(L) = |M(L) − g_M| / |g_M|`, `g_M = a_2_FW_zeta = 2776.165389`, at `L ∈ {8,10,12}`. The gate is DIRECTION-NEUTRAL on the C_1 sign and is a GENUINE gate that CAN FAIL: §VII.AU is the standing `(d=4,s=3)` counterexample — a sibling that under-performs the asymptotic `L⁻³` envelope at finite L (empirical `2.6926 > 3`). On PASS (`res(L=10) < 1e-3` ∧ `res(L) ∝ L⁻³`), the §VII.CB Level-3 row promotes HELD → SATISFIED and §VII.CB earns full REGISTRY-PASS.

This wave has NO intra-session upstream-verdict prerequisite (it is the headline genuine CF; it does not consume any other S107 wave's output). All four upstream inputs are STATIC artifacts that already exist on disk (SHA-pinned in the Input-SHA Ledger below):

- §VII.CB held-tag registry annotation — applied by `mack-cosmic-bridge` at S106 close (the held Level-3 row this gate discharges). This is a registry-state precondition, not a verdict prerequisite; the gate does not read the registry, it computes the magnitude anchor whose PASS the orchestrator routes to mack for the HELD → SATISFIED promotion.

- S106 W3-2 binding-envelope npz (`a8efd183…`) — the Level-2 `L⁻³` comparator. Present on disk.
- `s84_spectrum_cache_L12_tau019.npz` (`9e6d9cf7…`) — the L=12 master spectrum at τ_fold=0.190. Present on disk.

If any static input fails its SHA pin at dispatch time, the gate honestly closes PRE-REG-INC per `.claude/rules/mechanical-closure-discipline.md` (the magnitude channel cannot be evaluated against a drifted input); this is NOT expected — all four SHAs were verified at plan-freeze (2026-06-13).

      Definition 4: Level2(L=10) = L_max^{−3}|_{L=10} = 1e-3 [binding L⁻³ envelope; canonical_constants.py L_envelope_d4_Lmax10; S106 W3-2 audit 943b17ad…; loaded from npz a8efd183…, NOT hardcoded]
      Substitute:   PASS_A  ⇔  res(L=10) < Level2(L=10)
                            ⇔  |M(L=10) − g_M| / |g_M| < 1e-3
      Simplify:     ⇔  |M(L=10) − 2776.165389| / 2776.165389 < 0.001
                    ⇔  |M(L=10) − 2776.165389| < 2.776165389         [multiply both sides by |g_M| > 0]
      Canonical form: M(L=10) ∈ (2776.165389 − 2.776165, 2776.165389 + 2.776165) = (2773.389, 2778.941)
      Direction:    res is a magnitude (|·| ≥ 0); PASS_A is the strict-below relation res(L=10) < 1e-3;
                    the inequality direction is FIXED by the residual being a distance, NOT by any
                    predicted sign of (M(L=10) − g_M). (The SIGN of M(L=10) − g_M is the C_1
                    diagnostic — see the NON-CHAINED note below.)
      Conclusion A: PASS_A iff M(L=10) lands within ±2.776 of g_M. GENUINE — §VII.AU proves a
                    (d=4,s=3) sibling can land OUTSIDE its analytic envelope at finite L
                    (empirical exponent 2.6926 < 3 ⇒ slower-than-asymptotic convergence ⇒ a
                    finite-L residual that can exceed the envelope). So PASS_A can FAIL.

    Claim B (FLOWING signature direction): "PASS requires res(L) to DECREASE with L as a power law
    with |exponent| bounded away from zero (the FLOWING confirmation that M is the bound
    observable, contrasting the analytically-FLAT sign channel)."
      Definition 5: alpha_fit = slope of [log res(L) vs log L] over L ∈ {8,10,12}   [least-squares power-law fit]
      Definition 6: FLOWING ⇔ res(L) ∝ L^{alpha_fit} with alpha_fit < 0 (DECREASING) and |alpha_fit| ∈ [2.0,4.0]
      Substitute:   The analytically-FLAT sign channel S(L) has res_S(L) = const (no L_max axis;
                    multiplicative-normalization cancellation, K=3 MANDATORY: S = w(L_max)·g(geom),
                    w cancels in the dimensionless r_g/anec ratios ⇒ d log res_S / d log L = 0).
                    The magnitude channel M, IF it is the observable the L⁻³ envelope bounds, must
                    have d log res_M / d log L ≈ −3 (the envelope rate) — NON-zero, DECREASING.
      Simplify:     PASS_B ⇔ alpha_fit < 0 AND |alpha_fit| ∈ [2.0, 4.0]
      Canonical form: alpha_fit ∈ [−4.0, −2.0]
      Direction:    DECREASING (alpha_fit < 0) is the FLOWING direction; this IS a direction claim,
                    and it is chained here because it is the gate's pre-registered signature — it
                    distinguishes the FLOWING magnitude channel from the FLAT sign channel. It is
                    NOT the C_1 sign (which is sign(M−g_M), an orthogonal quantity).
      Conclusion B: PASS_B iff res(L) flows as a decreasing power law with |exponent| in [2,4].
                    A FLAT alpha_fit ≈ 0 would mean M is ALSO multiplicative-normalization-flat
                    (the SAME defect the sign channel has) ⇒ the magnitude channel would NOT be
                    the envelope-bound observable ⇒ FAIL the discharge.

    NON-CHAINED (C_1 sign — DIAGNOSTIC ONLY, explicitly NOT a pre-registered direction):

      writing a substitution chain that ASSERTS a C_1 sign would be a Class-8.2 PRU smuggle /
      dual-prior violation. The dual_prior block below records the two tracks WITHOUT pre-judging.

# ---- Verdict rubric (3 fields) ----
PASS_meaning: >
  res(L=10) < 1e-3 (the binding Level-2 envelope at canonical L_max) AND res(L) flows as a
  decreasing power law with |alpha_fit| ∈ [2.0,4.0]. The magnitude channel M(L) =
  Tr_{M₂(ℂ)}(P_a₂·T^{(IV)})|_L IS the FLOWING observable the L⁻³ envelope bounds, and it
  converges to g_M fast enough to satisfy the registry-PASS criterion at L_max=10. Solution-space
  consequence: the §VII.CB Level-3 row promotes HELD → SATISFIED; §VII.CB earns FULL REGISTRY-PASS
  (Level-3 < Level-2 on the CORRECT, binding-channel-consistent observable); the §VII.AX
  surgical-demotion is reversed for §VII.CB. The C_1 sign is reported as a diagnostic (which fork,
  §VII.AF.1-negative or §VII.AU-positive, the type-IV a₂ cocycle/projector geometry sits on).
FAIL_meaning: >
  EITHER res(L=10) ≥ 1e-3 (the magnitude channel does NOT bind inside the Level-2 envelope at
  canonical L_max — the §VII.AU pattern of finite-L under-performance realized on §VII.CB) OR the
  res(L) scaling is NOT a decreasing power law with |alpha_fit| ∈ [2.0,4.0] (the magnitude channel
  is NOT the envelope-bound FLOWING observable — e.g. it is itself multiplicative-normalization-flat,
  meaning the type-IV construction does not carry the a₂-magnitude content the envelope bounds).
  Solution-space consequence: the §VII.CB Level-3 row STAYS HELD `NOT-SATISFIED-PENDING-MAGNITUDE-
  CONVERGENCE-ANCHOR`; §VII.CB does NOT earn full REGISTRY-PASS this session; the magnitude channel
  re-routes to a S108 remediation (a different lift convention per the DST-T-3 alternative, OR a
  higher-L mesh {12,14,16} to test whether convergence is merely slow-but-eventual). This is a
  CONSTRAINT-MAP UPDATE, not an agent failure: a FAIL would confirm that §VII.AU's finite-L
  under-performance is a GENERIC (d=4,s=3) phenomenon reaching §VII.CB, sharpening the framework's
  topology→analysis over-reach boundary.
INFO_meaning: >
  PRE-REG-INC (PRU Class-8 cardinality) if the DST-T-3 lift sub-pin cannot be resolved at runtime
  (e.g. the S105 npz Γ_sub profile is structurally incompatible with the spectral-radius dictionary
  AND no canonical lift is found) — the FLOWING-vs-FLAT check would be lift-dependent and the gate
  is untestable as pinned; honest closure per mechanical-closure-discipline.md, deferred to S108
  with the lift-convention question routed to a substrate-physics workshop (OQ-3). ALSO INFO if a
  static input fails its SHA pin at dispatch (input drift; the magnitude channel cannot be evaluated
  against a drifted T^{(IV)} or envelope). NOTE: a clean res(L=10) ≥ 1e-3 with a clean L⁻³ flow is a
  FAIL, not INFO — the gate genuinely closes the magnitude-binding question.

## Wave 1 → Wave 2 Decision Point

Wave 2 (the Stage-2 verification cohort {K2, K7, K9, K11}) does NOT consume any Wave 1 output — the waves are independent. This gate's outcome routes only to the §VII.CB registry row (via mack on PASS) and to the next-session carry-forward queue on FAIL/INFO:

- **PASS** → route the §VII.CB Level-3 HELD → SATISFIED promotion to `mack-cosmic-bridge` (sole writer of `permanent-results-registry.md`); §VII.CB earns full REGISTRY-PASS; record the C_1 sign diagnostic in the WP (which fork, §VII.AF.1 / §VII.AU); no S108 carry-forward.
- **FAIL** → the §VII.CB Level-3 row STAYS HELD; emit a 4-field S108 carry-forward `CF-S108-VIICB-MAGNITUDE-REMEDIATION` (what: re-test the magnitude channel under the DST-T-3 alternative lift OR a {12,14,16} higher-L mesh; inputs: this gate's res(L) series + the alternative-lift convention; gate: res(L=10) < 1e-3 under the alternative OR convergence-to-below-1e-3 demonstrated by the L-trend; effort: ~1.0); record the FAIL as a constraint-map update (the §VII.AU finite-L under-performance reaches §VII.CB).
- **INFO (PRE-REG-INC)** → route the DST-T-3 lift-convention question (OQ-3: is there a FORCED r ↔ D_K-spectrum correspondence?) to a substrate-physics workshop via `/rclab-investigate`; emit a 4-field carry-forward to re-run once the lift is canonical; §VII.CB Level-3 row STAYS HELD pending the lift resolution.
